blockchain.title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
blockchain.excerpt: Bitcoin fell to its lowest leve since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

blockchain.title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
blockchain.excerpt: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

blockchain.title: Crypto for Advisors: The blockchain built to run financial markets
Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
blockchain.excerpt: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

blockchain.title: DTCC to Bring Tokenized Stocks and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
blockchain.excerpt: Wall Street's main settlement firm will add Solana to its tokenization service, which went live last month on Canton and a private network.

defi.title: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi
defi.excerpt: The DOJ, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition led by a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap filed briefs backing a lawsuit to strike down the state’s 0.2% levy on digital asset transactions.

defi.title: Anchorage Digital’s Stablecoins Can Now Settle Payments on Visa’s Network
defi.excerpt: Visa and eligible companies can now use Western Union’s USDPT—issued and custodied by the federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank—to settle VisaNet obligations.

defi.title: Tether Gold Gets Clean KPMG Audit Confirming $2.2B in Physical Gold Backing
defi.excerpt: KPMG counted every gold bar behind XAUT, making it Tether's second stablecoin to complete a full audit by a Big Four accounting firm.

defi.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
defi.excerpt: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

defi.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
defi.excerpt: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.
